readme.text:
> DeepSeek Harness (DSH / Cordis) 的全功能用量监控、成本核算与诊断大盘插件。

[](https://nodejs.org/)
[](LICENSE)
[]()

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

---

`dsh-usage-board` 是专为 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 设计的用量与成本可视化看板插件。

插件能实时捕获会话内的 Token 消耗、Step 耗时和异常指标，支持冷启动增量回溯历史全量会话，并按 Sub-agent DAG 调用关系进行树状归集与反向明细穿透。

---
插件通过宿主 Slot 系统在三处无缝挂载 UI（前端为轻量无状态设计 `lib/client.js`）：侧边栏底部的 **Usage Board** 按钮一键唤出全屏大盘，会话详情页自带 **Usage** Tab 查看单会话账单。

readme.section: 会话页 "Usage" Tab —— 单会话账单与诊断
readme.text: 树级聚合 KPI（输入 / 输出 = 思考 + 正文 / 缓存命中 / 成本）、Token 五桶构成 × 峰谷金额（零桶自动隐藏）、模型占比、请求效率与逐步明细。悬停行内 **?** 可查看该桶峰 / 谷两档实付单价与金额对照（谷价 = 峰价 × ½）：
总量 / 成本 / 缓存命中率 KPI，DeepSeek 官方余额与烧钱速率预测（含夜间/阶梯价反事实节约），84 天用量热力图与 24 小时峰谷剖面。

readme.section: 全屏大盘 (Overlay) —— 会话归集与 Turns 明细
readme.text: 最近会话树状归集、Turn × Step 级明细（TTFT / 耗时 / 五桶 Token / 峰谷金额），一键 CSV 导出。

| 挂载 Slot | 位置 | 展示内容 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `conversation.view` | 会话详情页 "Usage" Tab | 当前会话树级聚合指标、Token 五桶构成 × 峰谷成本、模型占比、Step 级耗时瀑布 |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | 侧边栏底部操作区 | 大盘常驻快捷开闭图标 |
| `shell.overlay` | 全屏监控大盘 (Overlay) | 余额与可用天数、异常与反事实节约 KPI、84 天热力图、24 小时峰谷剖面、最近会话归集、Turns 明细表及 CSV 导出 |

---

- ⚡ **零运行时依赖**：基于 Node.js 22.5+ 原生 `node:sqlite` 构建，无任何 C++ 原生编译依赖及 Worker 进程负担。
- 🏛️ **CQRS 架构**：DSH 会话原文件作为**只读真相源 (Write Model)**，插件 SQLite 数据库作为**可重建只读视图 (Read Model)**，保障会话数据安全。
- 🚀 **暖/热双层读模型**：
  - **暖层 (SQLite)**：按脏分区增量汇总 `daily_rollups` / `session_rollups`，动态按最新价目表现算成本。
  - **热层 (内存快照)**：进程内不可变快照，单次请求下发渲染就绪的主帧；支持 `rev` 版本号协商，无变更秒回 `unchanged`。
- 🌲 **Sub-agent DAG 聚合分析**：支持多层子代理深度调用链聚合、Step 耗时瀑布图、Token 五桶构成分析。
- 💰 **成本与余额洞察**：支持 DeepSeek 官方余额透传、实时额度可用天数预测、夜间/阶梯价反事实节约计算。
- 🖥️ **三处无缝 UI 挂载**：原生融入 DSH Web 控制台（会话页 Tab、侧边栏入口、全屏仪表盘）。

- **Node.js** >= `22.5.0`
- **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)**

readme.section: 2. 作为 DSH 插件启用
readme.text: ```bash

readme.section: 1. 克隆并构建（仓库不含 lib/ 产物，必须先构建）
readme.text:
git clone https://github.com/zhm20001/dsh-usage-board.git
cd dsh-usage-board
npm install
npm run build

readme.section: 2. 将插件注册至 DSH Web Profile
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)"

readme.section: 3. 启动 DSH Web 宿主
readme.text:
dsh --profile web --port 3099
```

启动后访问 `http://127.0.0.1:3099` 即可在界面中看到用量看板。首次启动会冷启动回溯扫描全部历史会话，之后增量跟进。

---

大盘的「账户余额」组件读取 DeepSeek 官方 `GET /user/balance` 接口：

1. **方式一**：在 DSH 的「设置 → 模型」中填入 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。
2. **方式二**：写入 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`（权限需设置为 `0600`）：
   ```yaml
   DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
   ```

> *注：未配置 Key 时余额卡片展示占位符，不影响其余本地统计功能。余额查询是本插件唯一的外网请求，其余处理均在纯本地执行。*

| 类别 | 存储位置 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **真相源 (Write Model)** | `~/.dsh/sessions/<projectKey>/<sessionId>/session.jsonl.zstd` | DSH 原始会话，只读 |
| **投影库 (Read Model)** | `~/.dsh/data/usage.sqlite` | 插件维护的 SQLite 索引与聚合库 |

> 💡 **可安全重建**：投影库可随时删除重建（建议先停用插件，再 `rm ~/.dsh/data/usage.sqlite*`）。下次启动 Backfill 会重扫全部历史会话重建投影；Write Model 永远不要删。

---

| 端点 | 方法 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/api/usage-dashboard/snapshot?rev=N` | `GET` | 获取大盘全量主帧。`rev` 命中当前版本时返回 `{unchanged: true, revision}` |
| `/api/usage-dashboard/snapshot?refresh=1` | `GET` | 强制出网刷新一次 DeepSeek 实时余额 |
| `/api/usage-dashboard/turns` | `GET` | 检索 Turns 明细列表。参数：`limit`（默认 500、上限 500）、`session_id`、`root_session_id`（二者可同给取交集）、`format=csv` |

端点仅在注入 `ctx.webServer` 时注册（回环 same-origin 限定）；未注入时引擎作为库完整可用。
```bash

readme.section: 构建 Node 端与 Client 端产物
readme.text: npm run build

readme.section: 启动监听构建（配合 DSH 宿主的 Client HMR 热替换）
readme.text: npm run dev

readme.section: 运行全量测试套件（基于 node --test，无外部依赖）
readme.text: npm test

npm run typecheck
```

> A full-featured usage monitoring, cost accounting, and diagnostics dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH / Cordis).

[](https://nodejs.org/)
[](LICENSE)
[]()

[简体中文](README.md) | **English**

---

`dsh-usage-board` is a usage and cost visualization dashboard plugin designed for DSH (DeepSeek Harness).

It captures in-session token consumption, step latency, and anomaly metrics in real time, supports cold-start incremental backfill of all historical sessions, and aggregates usage along the Sub-agent DAG call tree with drill-down into per-step details.

---

The plugin mounts its UI in three places via the host's slot system (the frontend is a lightweight stateless design, `lib/client.js`): the **Usage Board** button at the bottom of the sidebar opens the fullscreen dashboard, and the conversation page ships a built-in **Usage** tab for per-session accounting.

Tree-level KPIs (input / output = thinking + content / cache hit / cost), five-bucket token composition × peak/off-peak cost (zero buckets hidden automatically), model breakdown, request efficiency, and per-step detail. Hover the inline **?** to see that bucket's peak / off-peak unit price and amount side by side (off-peak = peak × ½):
Volume / cost / cache-hit KPIs, official DeepSeek balance with burn-rate forecast (incl. off-peak/counterfactual savings), an 84-day usage heatmap, and a 24-hour peak/off-peak profile.
Recent sessions aggregated by call tree, Turn × Step detail (TTFT / duration / five token buckets / peak-off-peak cost), one-click CSV export.

| Slot | Location | Content |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `conversation.view` | Conversation page "Usage" tab | Tree-level aggregate metrics, five-bucket token composition × peak/off-peak cost, model breakdown, step-level duration waterfall |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | Sidebar footer | Always-on toggle button for the dashboard |
| `shell.overlay` | Fullscreen dashboard (Overlay) | Balance & remaining days, anomaly & counterfactual-savings KPIs, 84-day heatmap, 24h peak/off-peak profile, recent sessions, turns detail table with CSV export |

- ⚡ **Zero runtime dependencies**: built on Node.js 22.5+ native `node:sqlite` — no native C++ compilation, no worker processes.
- 🏛️ **CQRS architecture**: DSH session files are the **read-only source of truth (Write Model)**; the plugin's SQLite database is a **rebuildable read-only projection (Read Model)**, keeping session data safe.
- 🚀 **Warm/hot two-layer read model**:
  - **Warm layer (SQLite)**: incremental `daily_rollups` / `session_rollups` per dirty partition; costs recomputed on the fly against the latest price schedule.
  - **Hot layer (in-memory snapshot)**: an immutable in-process snapshot served render-ready in one request; `rev` version negotiation answers `unchanged` instantly when nothing changed.
- 🌲 **Sub-agent DAG aggregation**: multi-level sub-agent call-chain aggregation, step-duration waterfalls, five-bucket token composition analysis.
- 💰 **Cost & balance insights**: official DeepSeek balance passthrough, live burn-down forecast, off-peak/counterfactual savings computation.
- 🖥️ **Three seamless UI mounts**: natively embedded in the DSH web console (conversation tab, sidebar entry, fullscreen dashboard).

- **Node.js** >= `22.5.0`
- **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)**
```bash

readme.section: 1. Clone and build (the repo ships no lib/ output — build first)
readme.text:
git clone https://github.com/zhm20001/dsh-usage-board.git
cd dsh-usage-board
npm install
npm run build

readme.section: 2. Register the plugin with a DSH web profile
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)"

dsh --profile web --port 3099
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:3099` — the usage board is right in the console. The first launch backfills all historical sessions via a cold-start scan; afterwards it follows incrementally.

---

The dashboard's **Balance** card reads the official DeepSeek `GET /user/balance` endpoint:

1. **Option 1**: fill in `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` under DSH "Settings → Models".
2. **Option 2**: write it to `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (permissions must be `0600`):
   ```yaml
   DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
   ```
> *Note: without a key the balance card shows a placeholder; all other local statistics are unaffected. The balance query is the plugin's only outbound request — everything else runs purely locally.*

| Kind | Location | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Source of truth (Write Model)** | `~/.dsh/sessions/<projectKey>/<sessionId>/session.jsonl.zstd` | Original DSH sessions, read-only |
| **Projection (Read Model)** | `~/.dsh/data/usage.sqlite` | SQLite index & aggregation DB maintained by the plugin |

> 💡 **Safe to rebuild**: the projection DB can be deleted and rebuilt at any time (stop the plugin first, then `rm ~/.dsh/data/usage.sqlite*`). The next launch re-scans all historical sessions via backfill; never delete the Write Model.

---

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/api/usage-dashboard/snapshot?rev=N` | `GET` | Full dashboard main frame. If `rev` matches the current version, returns `{unchanged: true, revision}` |
| `/api/usage-dashboard/snapshot?refresh=1` | `GET` | Force one outbound refresh of the live DeepSeek balance |
| `/api/usage-dashboard/turns` | `GET` | Turns detail list. Params: `limit` (default 500, max 500), `session_id`, `root_session_id` (both may be combined for intersection), `format=csv` |
Endpoints are registered only when `ctx.webServer` is injected (loopback same-origin only); without it the engine still works fully as a library.
```bash

readme.section: Build both the Node and client bundles
readme.text: npm run build

readme.section: Watch mode (pairs with the DSH host's client HMR hot swap)
readme.text: npm run dev

readme.section: Run the full test suite (node --test, no external dependencies)
readme.text: npm test

npm run typecheck
```
